HOME COURTYARD
The patched porch and stacked wood make this place easy to recognize from the lane. The dispatcher is taking runners inside the courier hall on the eastern street.

[E] Continue

WORKTABLE
The worktable is clear, with room to lay out your next task.

FIRST ROUTE  /  Speak to the dispatcher
ROUTE BOARD  /  Assignment open

[E] Continue

REST CORNER
A teal quilt covers the bed. A small cabinet and woven mat keep this corner separate from the working floor.

[E] Continue

HOME STOVE
An iron stove rests beside a stack of split wood. The clear center floor leaves room to pass between it and the worktable.

[E] Continue
